messages.subject: Chadwick Alumni Interested in Banking @ Houlihan
messages.body:
Hi Kate,

I hope you are doing well. I am a Chadwick Class of '22 graduate and
currently attend UT Austin studying Business and Economics. I'm pursuing a
career in Investment Banking, so I'd love to learn more about your
experience with Houlihan in LA.

If you have any free time in the next week, it would be great to set up a
quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my
schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if
you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,

Jonathan
